text:
lina (marketing): Heads-up thread for Monday launch — plan to publish announcement and send email at 07:30 PT. Need final changelog PR, live docs URL, benchmark graphics, webinar CTA, and first-48h lead routing. Who's owning what?
sam (eng): Working on changelog PR #478, includes full migration notes for legacy keys and the minor API surface change. Aiming to have it merged by EOD Sun.
tay (product): Once PR merges Ill trigger the docs build. I can post the staging link and then swap to prod after deploy.
pat (devex): Marketing, share the official embed for the webinar registration (iframe/snippet) so I can add it to the quickstart and examples.
lina (marketing): Webinar planned Wed 11:00 PT — 45min (demo + Q&A). Benchmark narrative: 4 bullets (95p latency, token cost per 1k, throughput tokens/sec, and memory footprint). We need PNGs and a short blurb for each.
noah (eng): We'll produce plots for prod-optimized, quantized-cost, and lowlatency-small variants. Ill export SVGs + a CSV with p50/p95 and tokens/sec. Drop ETA = today 18:00 PT.
sam (eng): Also note: small breaking change in header validation. In changelog we'll include a migration snippet. Marketing: prefer softer phrasing like "update your headers to the new validation" with link to migration steps.
lina (marketing): Got it. Draft copy: "Please update headers to the new validation rules to avoid 4xx responses after the rollout. See migration steps below." Will include a tiny code block.
sam (eng): Proposed snippet: ```bash
# rotate and update header example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys/rotate -H "Authorization: Bearer OLD_KEY" -d '{"scope":"service"}'
```
pat (devex): I'll trim that to a single-line snippet for quickstart and link full migration guide in docs.
riley (sales ops): For leads: I'll create a "launch_priority" tag and route to inbound-sdr. Need final landing URL + UTMs.
lina (marketing): Landing URL = /product/launch/perf-compare (final path after docs deploy). Use utm_campaign=redwood_launch_q2_1972 and utm_medium=newsletter. Riley, please wire tagging for 72h after launch and escalate to enterprise-sdr for any lead with company size >200.
riley (sales ops): Copy that — will do 72h window and escalation rule. Need final URL when prod is live.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: docs/staging -> prod in approx 2h. CI: passed, smoke-checks queued.
sam (eng): Canary rollout plan: 5% traffic first 30m, 25% next 2h, 100% over 12h. Auto-rollback on errors >0.8% or latency spike >50% over baseline. Marketing: add a note about staged rollout in the FAQ.
lina (marketing): We'll include that line. Also want a pre-send confirm from eng 20m before publish to verify quick perf check. Can someone post a green/yellow/red status here?
sam (eng): Will run quick smoke 20m prior and post results here (p50, p95, error rate).
tay (product): I'll post the staging link once build completes and then prod URL after deploy.
sam (eng): Perf assets uploaded (internal): https://internal.redwood/assets/launch1972/perf_bundle.zip  will add marketing-safe images to the shared drive.
lina (marketing): Perfect. I'll draft the announcement doc (one-pager summary, links to changelog & full migration guide, bench slides, webinar CTA, and FAQ including rollout and lead routing). Posting final copy 1 hour before launch for approvals. :megaphone:
pat (devex): Ill also add the migration snippet into the quickstart example and the SDK README.
riley (sales ops): Once you drop the final URL Ill validate the automation and send a test lead through.
lina (marketing): Thanks team. If any timing slips, call it out here ASAP. Will schedule webinar invite after slides are finalized. :rocket:
